title: Client information addition file (Finspot OMS, Client Information - Addition)
purpose: Finspot's shorter client addition upload (22 columns; it looks like an older form of Investor Client, whose sheet has the same fields in the same places with some left unnamed). Written for the same clients as the Investor Client file and with the same values: account ID (UCC), name, branch, e-mail, residence address, mobile, client group, decimal preference 2, PAN, client type, status A. The unnamed columns are left empty; columns 4 and 5 sit where Investor Client has the password and transaction password and are never written. Office address is left empty (Ledgerline does not hold it).
